messages:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync — onboarding NovaModels (open weights) into our marketplace + HW/SI bundle. Need: licensing terms signoff, redistribution/export guardrails, co-announce plan with Nova and HW partner, and packaging checklist for SI. Draft contract: https://git.redwood/repo/nova-onboard/draft-v1.pdf
Alex (legal): I skimmed the draft. High level: add explicit geo-restriction/embargo clause, clarify redistribution vs hosting (we MUST prevent downstream rehosting if vendor requests), and add export control paragraph. Suggest this snippet for export control:
```
Provider warrants model does not include restricted-origin data; customer must comply with export laws; Redwood reserves right to geoblock.
```
Priya (partnerships-ops): For co-announce: Nova wants joint blog + cloud marketplace tile. HW partner (Elena) requested a mention in the marketplace tile. We need embargo window — Nova asked for 2 weeks. Is that okay for us?
Sam (eng-infra): For packaging, we need: model artifacts (HF + quantized), signature/sha256, and a verified inference test script. Also: do we require a quantized artifact we host or do we host a conversion pipeline? If SI will bundle, we need a stable artifact URL. Example artifact naming: `nova-3b-quant-v1.safetensors`
Elena (nova-hw): Happy to be on the tile. HW team also wants a short blurb about optimized kernels and a link to our validator. We can provide a vetted runtime image (docker) for the SI bundle. ETA to handover artifacts: 5 business days after contract sign.
Jorge (product): Timeline check — marketing wants a target launch week. If contract sign this Fri (EOD), ops + eng can validate in ~10 business days, then canary in dedicated for 3 days. Proposed launch: 3 weeks from contract sign. Is that aggressive?
Dan (SI-lead): For the SI bundle we need clear support matrix: supported HW SKUs, driver versions, and fallback plan if quantization regresses. Also need a tech contact for post-launch incidents. We'll require a small deploy repo + instructions.
Casey (marketing): For PR cadence: 1) embargoed blog post to partners 2) marketplace listing live at announce time 3) optional joint webinar 1 week after. Need final logos and one-sentence partner blurbs by Monday. Also: is there a customer reference in the plan or just joint vendor announcement?
Alex (legal): On redistribution: if Nova's license permits redistribution, add a controlled redistribution addendum that only allows distribution through approved marketplaces/SIs and requires attribution + provenance metadata. Also include a revocation clause: if provider flags misuse, we can delist.
ContractBot: Contract draft v1 -> status: REVIEW_REQUESTED by Alex (legal). Checklist: export clause missing, geoblock language missing, attribution requirement missing.
Maya (partnerships): Action items I have captured:
- Alex: provide exact clause language for geo + redistribution (due today EOD)
- Sam: list validation tests + artifact naming convention (due Tue)
- Elena: deliver docker runtime + artifact ETAs (5 business days post-sign)
- Dan: SI bundle requirements doc (support matrix + deploy repo) due Wed
- Casey/Jorge: announce timeline & assets list (logos + blurbs) due Mon
We'll aim to sign contract this Fri. If legal flags any blocking terms, pause announcement. :thumbsup:
Priya (partnerships-ops): I'll schedule a 30m sync for tomorrow 10:30 PT with Nova/HW/Legal/Eng to walk the checklist. Calendar invite incoming.
Maya (partnerships): Thanks all — please drop any roadblocks in this thread. If anyone needs the draft link again: https://git.redwood/repo/nova-onboard/draft-v1.pdf
Alex (legal): I'll post the suggested clause inline here after lunch.
Sam (eng-infra): I'll add the CI test stub to repo `infra/model-validations/nova` and ping when ready.
Elena (nova-hw): Noted — will prep runtime and send credentials to Ops.
Dan (SI-lead): We'll prep the deploy repo skeleton and a sample runbook.
Casey (marketing): Adding PR checklist to the shared drive now.
Maya (partnerships): Great — closing loop for now. Follow-up after tomorrow's sync.
